outcome: Ureaplasma spp lower airway tract infection
cohort: 415 infants born <33 weeks gestational age from five cohorts enrolled between 1999-2016
finding: Three predictive models were developed that showed high predictive ability for identifying infants with lower airway Ureaplasma infection based on gestational age, rupture of membranes >72 hours, admission white blood cell count, and delivery route.
mod_finding: Delivery route was found to be a predictive factor for lower airway Ureaplasma infection in preterm infants when laboratory values were excluded from the model.
